subject: Duplicate records in record table when images are 0 seconds apart - is there a fix?

messages.author: 44c445bae4eebd56
messages.subject: Duplicate records in record table when images are 0 seconds apart - is there a fix?
parts:
I have been able to successfully generate a record table and export as a csv, using the recordTable function. I have set the minDeltaTime to 60 minutes, with delta time compared to last record (see code below). However, I am running into issues where multiple records are generated when there should only be one record (given the minDeltaTime of 60).

This is only happening in a specific case: when two images have the exact same date, time, location, & species, they are appearing as two separate records. (My cameras are set to take photos in bursts of 2, with a 30 second quiet period, so as a result, many pairs of images are taken at the exact same time.) Otherwise, the minDeltaTime seems to be working, when there is >=1 second between photos of the same species.

database <- recordTable(inDir = "Merged_photos",      
                        IDfrom = "directory",
                        minDeltaTime = 60,
                        deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord",
                        timeZone = "Africa/Maputo", 
                        stationCol = "Camera",
                        writecsv = TRUE, 
                        removeDuplicateRecords = FALSE)

Anybody else encountering this problem, or know of a workaround?

Thanks!

Best,
Kaitlyn Gaynor
PhD Candidate
University of California - Berkeley
